newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed falls on lower overseas interest.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed falls on lower overseas interest.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell to 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal on Tuesday after rising to 1,181/1,182 rupees in early trade, dealers said.

"Absence of fresh overseas buying triggered light bull liquidation at the improved level," one dealer said. New crop arrivals of castorseed at producing centres have dropped in the last two days due to cold weather.
Dealers said foreign buyers were offering $680 per tonne for Indian castoroil against Indian sale offers of were at $690.
Groundnut oil fell by 2/3 rupees to 340 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish physical buying as well as higher availability of imported edible oil at Bombay port.
Palm oil was subdued on Tuesday and was quoted 2/3 rupees lower at 283/284 rupees per 10 kg on a re-sale basis, and at 285 rupees for direct delivery by importers.
Rajkot spot groundnut was steady at 515/520 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
